title: How to Show Your Impact at Work When You Built It From Scratch
status: Reference assets built and rendered in this batch. Not finished motion graphics.
note: No prior rendered V8 to V13 artwork exists. Every PNG here is a new build from a reusable concept, not a byte-identical reuse.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: NORMAL_NOW, from the Attachment B spec. Anchor remapped to the new opening.
teaching_assets.trigger: And that is exactly why your contribution can become harder to see.
teaching_assets.onscreen: NOW IT LOOKS EASY. / That is exactly why your contribution can become harder to see.
teaching_assets.purpose: The thumbnail line and the whole problem, on screen inside the first thirty seconds.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Headline alone for 1.4s. Support line at 2.0s. Gentle fade, no movement.
teaching_assets.emphasis: NOW IT LOOKS EASY dominates. The support line is secondary.
teaching_assets.hold: 6 to 7 seconds. The support line needs a full read.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the review and interview scene.
teaching_assets.captions: Suppress designed captions for the full hold.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one soft whoosh on the headline.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: DOCUMENTED_CASE, reshaped. The new script contrasts naming an output with showing the problem behind it.
teaching_assets.trigger: It names an output. It does not tell you why that output was needed or what had to be worked out before it could exist.
teaching_assets.onscreen: THE OUTPUT: I built a leadership framework / THE PROBLEM BEHIND IT: how broad expectations become usable in real decisions
teaching_assets.purpose: Makes the central distinction concrete using the documented life-sciences account.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Left column while the weak sentence is read, held alone 2.0s. Right column on the reframe. Closing line 1.4s later.
teaching_assets.emphasis: The right column carries more weight.
teaching_assets.hold: 9 to 10 seconds across both spoken versions.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the self-introduction.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one restrained accent as the right column arrives.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: This frame carries the DOCUMENTED life-sciences account. It must stay separate from the hypothetical intake example, which is labelled wherever it appears. No manager count, baseline, improvement figure or sole-person credit appears here or anywhere.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: BEFORE, from the Attachment B spec. Weak versus useful, using the script's own two sentences.
teaching_assets.onscreen: THE WEAK VERSION: It was chaos / THE MORE USEFUL VERSION: there was no shared way to prioritize requests
teaching_assets.purpose: The first framework step, shown as the comparison the script performs out loud.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Weak version first, alone, 1.8s. Useful version on the reframe. Closing warning line at 4.0s.
teaching_assets.emphasis: The useful version. The closing warning is the guard rail.
teaching_assets.hold: 10 to 11 seconds. The right column is a long sentence and needs the time.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the sentence stem.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one soft click as the useful version arrives.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: The intake process is hypothetical. The stamp must stay readable. It is not another real Temidayo case.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: JUDGMENT, from the Attachment B spec, rewritten to the four questions the new script actually asks.
teaching_assets.onscreen: What was not obvious at the start? / What options existed? / What did I recommend, decide, or bring into agreement? / Which constraint made that choice difficult?
teaching_assets.purpose: The four questions that surface judgment. The viewer will screenshot this.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One question at a time, 1.1s apart, as each is spoken. Hold the complete set.
teaching_assets.emphasis: Equal weight. This is a checklist, not a hierarchy.
teaching_assets.hold: 10 to 12 seconds. The longest hold in the video.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the attribution warning.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one soft accent per question, or none at all. Do not play four accents just because there are four questions.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: PROOF_LEVEL, from the Attachment B spec. The evidence distinction the brief calls out as important.
teaching_assets.onscreen: EXISTENCE: it was created / USE: people actually used it / EFFECT: evidence that something important changed
teaching_assets.purpose: The distinction that keeps the whole video honest.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One level at a time, 1.2s apart. The closing line arrives after a clear beat, at display weight.
teaching_assets.emphasis: The closing line. It is the instruction, not a footnote.
teaching_assets.hold: 11 to 12 seconds. Each level needs its definition read.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the prevention-work passage.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one restrained click per level, then a single soft resolve on the closing line. Or fewer.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: Adoption is not measured effect. Do not let any state imply that creating a framework proves people became more capable.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: ACCOUNT, from the Attachment B spec, using the script's exact four-sentence stem.
teaching_assets.onscreen: Before this work, this was missing. / My part was this. / The judgment involved this. / What changed was this, and this is how I know.
teaching_assets.purpose: The deliverable of the whole video, in four lines the viewer can copy.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One sentence at a time, 1.0s apart. Hold the complete set for a long beat.
teaching_assets.emphasis: The fourth line. That is where the evidence boundary lives.
teaching_assets.hold: 11 to 13 seconds. This is the screenshot frame.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the worked example.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one accent as the set completes.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: SCOPE, from the Attachment B spec, focused on the script's own payoff line about the last sentence.
teaching_assets.trigger: That last sentence does not weaken the story. It tells the listener exactly where the evidence ends.
teaching_assets.onscreen: Its effect on turnaround time had not yet been established / That last sentence does not weaken the story
teaching_assets.purpose: Removes the fear that an honest boundary is a weak boundary.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the strip-the-acronyms test.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: none. Let this one land dry.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: Separate resource card, per the brief. Not combined with Watch Next.
teaching_assets.trigger: Keep the Proof is linked below if you want the deeper evidence system and reusable ledger.
teaching_assets.purpose: The single resource route, full screen, address readable on a phone.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the two closing lines.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one warm accent on the URL.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: Separate Watch Next card. Final visual.
teaching_assets.trigger: Watch “How to Change Industries Without Starting Over” next.
teaching_assets.onscreen: WATCH NEXT: HOW TO CHANGE INDUSTRIES WITHOUT STARTING OVER
teaching_assets.purpose: Final visual. Right of frame kept clear for the clickable end-screen element.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Static. No animation on the final card.
teaching_assets.hold: 10 to 14 seconds, through the final spoken line and the intentional closing hold.
teaching_assets.exit: NONE. This is the final visual. No camera return, no outro, nothing after it.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: none, then a natural 1 to 2 second music fade.
